messages: Elena (Design): dropping a short thread for the batch vectors preview + rerank export flow. Main things: microcopy for export modal, how to indicate "unsaved rerank" state, and keyboard affordances for the relevance column tooltip. Gif: https://rwd-assets/batch-preview-ux.gif Noah (Eng): saw the gif. quick notes: we should avoid autosubmit when switching rerank models. staged changes are easier and safer. Backend can take an explicit model_id param for exports. Priyanka (PM): agree on staged. copy suggestion for the export CTA: instead of just "Export", use "Start export" and smaller helper text: "Download link will be emailed when ready". Also ask: should export include current preview columns by default? Elena (Design): yes default to current preview columns, but show a checkbox in modal: "Include hidden columns" (off by default). For microcopy in the modal header: "Export vectors — include filters & rerank settings". Sam (Accessibility): a11y checklist: make relevance tooltips focusable buttons with aria-describedby pointing to tooltip content. Add role="grid" to the table and use aria-selected on rows. For the unsaved indicator, ensure it is text-based (e.g., "(unsaved)") not only a color/dot. Noah (Eng): implementation plan: stagedRerank vs appliedRerank. staged changes update preview scores client-side; appliedRerank is sent with export job. We'll persist selected row ids separately so toggling sampling/filters doesn't lose selection. Elena (Design): microcopy options for unsaved state on rerank selector: a) "Model: rerank-v2 (unsaved)" b) "Model: rerank-v2 — changes not applied" c) small badge "Unsaved" next to Apply button. Which reads best? Priyanka (PM): prefer a) or c). a) is concise inline, c) makes the action clearer. I'd pick c) if we can also show inline ephemeral text on hover: "Previewing scores. Click Apply to lock this model for exports." Sam (Accessibility): if you use a badge, ensure it's announced: e.g., include screen-reader-only text: "Unsaved rerank model" and update aria-live when it changes. Code hint: ``` Unsaved rerank model ``` Noah (Eng): for keyboard: arrow keys should move between rows; Space toggles selection; Enter opens the inspector. We'll use roving tabindex and manage focus with JS. Shift+Arrow for range select might be nice too. Elena (Design): export modal details: top area shows "Export summary" lines: filters applied, rerank model (active), row count, and estimated size. Add a small inline warning if >50k rows: "Large export — will be processed in background" with a link to docs. Priyanka (PM): logging: export email should include job id, filters, export columns, and rerank model id. Also include a small retry link for failed jobs. ExportBot: Export job queued: id=exp_01b2c. You'll get an email when complete. QA-Bot: Please add tests: keyboard nav across table, tooltip accessibility, unsaved badge visible and announced, selection persistence across filters. Elena (Design): thanks all. i'll push a tiny mock update with: "Start export" CTA copy, export modal fields, badge on Apply button, accessible tooltip buttons, and selection persistence indicators. Posting v2 in ~1.5h. :sparkles: Noah (Eng): ping me when v2 lands. I'll attach a simple storybook fixture for the table keyboard states. Priyanka (PM): i'll add acceptance criteria to the ticket.
